function.name: FGET_DIST
function.param: Maximun increase in thousandth of degree
function.abstract: It returns the distance between two points

description.p: This function increases the original angle like first parameter in the optimal direction to approach to destiny angle like second parameter. If the maximun increase is not sufficient to get the destiny, the function returns an angle displaced the maximun of thousandth in the direction adapted. If the maximun increase is sufficient, the function returns the destiny angle.
The value of maximun increase must be positive. The function will reduce or add this value according to the direction adapted to go to the destiny.

This function is useful to create processes that have a capacity of turn limited, as a tank in a game of superior perspective, which wants to aim in a concrete direction, (for example, towards other process, in which case can be useful to make use of GET_ANGLE).
